item.title: Katy Liftz: I talk a lot about decentering a man, which is why its ironic that one of my biggest accomplishments is…
item.dc:creator: Katy Liftz · Instagram
item.description:
I talk a lot about decentering a man, which is why its ironic that one of my biggest accomplishments is loving this man.

Loving him with the depth that I do took SO much work on myself to feel safe around a man in general.

When we dated I woke up in the night in a cold sweat sometimes, scared shitless at the level of vulnerability I was choosing by allowing him into my home.

Our wedding night I shook in the bathtub having panic attacks spiraling as every memory of abuse played across my eyelids in a flurry.

And it had nothing to do with him, and everything to do with the past I had experienced.

He was a friend to me the whole way. A best friend, who offered a laugh when I wanted one and silence when I needed to share.

The work he did to earn my favor was nothing in comparison to the work I did on myself to be able to love him so purely. I knew he deserved it.

He earned it every day for years as we worked together in perfect tandem as shipmates, and best friends.

I know I talk a lot about decentering men and I still 10/10 recommend that.

But I also recommend doing the work to heal from your hurt so that you can be loved and receive it in full.

You deserve it.

Do the work for you to move on, and let the worst day of your life become just another bad Tuesday.

1. US inflation is rising. The latest PCE data showed inflation increasing to 3.8% in October, up from 3.6% in September. Higher inflation could mean interest rates stay higher for longer, which puts pressure on gold.

2. One more important date to watch: US jobs data. Strong job numbers could reduce expectations of rate cuts, putting pressure on gold. Weak numbers could support gold prices.

item.description:
SIGMA Advanced Systems plant visit …

For his first interview, Kartheek Raju took us inside Sigma Advanced Systems in Sri City Planet.

We came to see what Sigma was building. We left with a bigger question.
What would it take for a company that makes aerospace components to build an entire aircraft?
In our recent Money Purse Know Your Company series, Kartheek Raju, Executive Vice Chairman of Sigma Advanced Systems, walked us through the company’s electronics and precision manufacturing facilities. These photos are from that visit.

On the factory floor, we saw some of the work Sigma does today. In the interview, Kartheek explained how he thinks about what comes next. What should Sigma build in-house? What capabilities can it gain through acquisitions? And once it buys a business, how does it bring that expertise into the group?

Bisleri is not mineral water!

In fact, Kinley, Aquafina, Rail Neer… none of these are mineral water. They are all packaged drinking water.

Examples of real mineral water: Vedica, Evian, Voss, Himalayan, Aava.

So what’s the actual difference?

Packaged Drinking Water:
• Can come from sources like borewells, groundwater or municipal supplies.
• Is treated using processes like RO, UV or ozonisation.
• Minerals may be added back during processing.

Natural Mineral Water:
• Comes from natural springs or underground aquifers.
• Gets its minerals naturally from its source.
• Has a naturally occurring mineral composition.

When I started the Label Padhega India movement, the focus was on the food industry. But I’m happy to see that the movement is now expanding beyond food.

Nvidia stock fell 14% yesterday!

Why? What went wrong with one of the biggest companies in the world?

Nvidia Is Now Facing:

1. SEC investigation into potential “accounting irregularities”

2. FBI investigation into “Chinese intelligence operations” involving Jensen Huang

3. Allegations of Jensen Huang having an affair with a Chinese spy

4. California investigation into allegedly “misleading shareholders”

5. Criminal investigation into Megaspeed over export control violations

6. Shareholder lawsuit over “undisclosed ties” between Jensen Huang and Megaspeed

7. Congressional investigation into alleged interference with the Megaspeed probe

8. Internal board investigation into “national security and corporate governance failures”

Just 14 days ago, none of these investigations had been publicly reported.

Talk about a turn of events.

The SEC probe is reportedly examining how Nvidia discloses revenue, including reporting sales by customers’ headquarters rather than billing addresses. With Jensen Huang no longer at the helm, finance chief Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO, and the company is expected to be more selective about how it funds AI companies and infrastructure projects.

The concern is no longer just how much Nvidia is earning, but how sustainable its growth is and whether its accounting can withstand regulatory scrutiny.

These are still ongoing investigations, not verdicts. But investors clearly have a lot of questions right now.

🇮🇳 DID YOU KNOW THE WORD “SUGAR” HAS INDIAN ROOTS?

Long before the world called it Sugar, ancient India had a Sanskrit word: Śarkarā (शर्करा).

Originally meaning gravel or small crystals, Śarkarā also came to describe crystalline sugar.

As sugar and its name traveled across civilizations, the word evolved:

🇮🇳 India (Sanskrit): Śarkarā
🇮🇷 Persia: Shakar
🌙 Arabic: Sukkar
🏛️ Medieval Latin: Succarum
🇫🇷 France: Sucre
🇬🇧 English: Sugar

Different languages. Different civilizations. One fascinating Indian linguistic root!

India played a pioneering role in the history of sugar, particularly in developing methods of crystallizing it.

But here’s the irony. 💔

The same India that contributed so much to the world’s sugar history is now facing an enormous metabolic health crisis.

Today, India has approximately 90 million adults living with diabetes, the second-highest number in the world.

We have every reason to celebrate our history, but also every reason to protect our future.

❤️ We gave the world a word for sugar. Let’s not let sugar-related health problems define our future.

This isn’t about fearing sugar. It’s about understanding nutrition, making informed choices, staying active, and protecting our metabolic health.

🇮🇳 Let’s be remembered for our contribution to sugar’s history, not for the burden of metabolic disease.

But that tax-free withdrawal is allowed only in specific cases like medical emergencies, unemployment, moving abroad, house construction, marriage, education, or reasons beyond your control. Not for random withdrawals.

2. Make sure your Date of Joining and Date of Exit are correctly updated by both your previous and current employer.
Fixing it later is possible, but the process becomes lengthy with a lot of back and forth.

3. Also, if there is a gap between your previous company’s Date of Exit and your new company’s Date of Joining, it does not break your continuous EPF service completely. Your service just pauses for that period and continues again once you join the new company.
